newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard Airlines cuts fares to 15 cities.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard Airlines cuts fares to 15 cities.

text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc said Thursday it reduced fares to all 15 of its destinations and reduced advance purchase requirements to three days.
Previous Vanguard promotions had varying advance purchase requirements of as much as 14 days, the company said.

The carrier said travelers must make their reservations by April 14 for travel between April 1 and October 1. The lowest fares are available for flights off-peak and other restrictions apply, Vanguard said.
Vanguard also said its "Super Twofer" program, which offers a free companion ticket for travelers who buy one full-fare coach seat, remains in effect for those who make reservations by May 20.
Vanguard shares closed off 1/16 Thursday at 2-1/16.
